summary: Dell Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a redomestication from Delaware to Texas effective July 1, 2026, approved by stockholders at the annual meeting. This is a procedural corporate governance change, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing describes shareholder rights modifications under Texas law, including a 3% ownership threshold for derivative lawsuits. Routine redomestications are not classified as special situations. No deal terms apply.
